simagent solve: Does layer order matter for back-scatter? At 1 MeV, compare
### Explanation The error indicates that the layers were not built with the
specified thicknesses. The layers were defined as 1 cm each, but the request asked
for 2 cm of lead followed by 10 cm of water. The script needs to adjust the layer
definitions to include the correct thicknesses. ### Corrected Script This script
now defines the layers with the correct thicknesses and builds the slabs with them.
The simulation results and standard errors are then extracted and submitted as
